title: Coral and the Oath
author: Beatrix Almeida
blurb: Kestrel Almeida, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
